title: AgEcon IrrigationYieldPanel

stats.done_summary: Completed the analysis of the field_year_panel dataset. Generated summary statistics, correlation matrices, and OLS regression models to assess the impact of groundwater quota enforcement on irrigation volumes and crop yields. Created visualizations (scatter plots with regression lines and a correlation heatmap) and saved them to report/images/. Wrote a comprehensive report in report/report.md detailing the methodology, results, and discussion, concluding that while enforcement did not significantly reduce water volume, it was associated with higher yields, suggesting improved water use efficiency.
